text:
rebecca: quick heads-up — saw three auto-fallbacks in the last hour during quota throttles. on-call is flip-happy because it's unclear if reverting helps. we need a small, fast "safety-leash" workflow to reduce churn.

sam: agree. lightweight idea: a "soft-hold" that pauses automatic fallback rollouts for a short window (e.g., 5m) while collecting a compact telemetry snapshot. not a full override, just a hold.

anya: nice. hold should be auditable and reversible. also include a one-line recommended action: "allow revert" / "keep fallback" based on quick heuristics. keep it very small in the UI.

rebecca: sketch API:
POST /v1/rollouts/{id}/safety-hold
{ "actor": "rebecca", "duration_secs": 300, "reason_code": "holding-for-investigation" }
Response: { "hold_id": "h-123", "safety_pass": true, "snapshot_id": "snap-9" }

sam: telemetry snapshot = last 30s metrics, top-3 error classes, quota-window snapshot, and 3 anonymized request traces. include a tiny confidence score (0-1) for the suggestion.

anya: UI microcopy: show a pill on the route header when a hold is active: "Safety hold (5m) — suggested: allow revert (0.72)". clicking opens snapshot panel. button to apply quick-revert if safety checks ok.

rebecca: server rules: holds should block automatic rollbacks only. manual operator revert still allowed but must create an audit event referencing snapshot_id. also enforce max 1 active hold per-route.

sam: safety check for quick-revert: allow if (error_delta <= 0.03 AND p95_delta_pct <= 12%). else disable quick-revert and show reason.

anya: security: rollout:operator role can create hold and apply quick-revert; rollout:viewer can only see snapshot. record session id and IP in audit. retention: 90d default for holds, 365d when correlated with incident.

ops-bot: job queued: safety-hold-runner -> staging

rebecca: small experiment idea: enable holds for 25% of internal routes and measure # of avoidable manual undos and mean time to resolution.

sam: implement notes: snapshot builder should be cheap — sample traces and compute lightweight histograms. keep payload small so audit storage doesn't blow up.

anya: also add machine-readable fallback_reason on fallback events (e.g., Fallback::Quota::Burst) to help the snapshot classifier.

rebecca: next steps: sam to proto the hold API + runner limits, anya to draft snapshot schema + IAM bits, i'll mock UI pill and write the AB plan. filing ticket now.

rebecca: filing: ENG-5982 (safety-hold quickpatch + snapshot) :sparkles:
